queries.query: What are the two formulations of Retrieval-Augmented Generation evaluated in the paper?
queries.gold_citation_passage: We compare two formulations: RAG-Sequence, which uses the same retrieved document across the whole sequence, and RAG-Token, which can select different documents per generated token.

queries.query: How did RAG perform on Natural Questions compared to closed-book T5-11B?

queries.query: By what percentage did Constitutional AI reduce harmful outputs on red-teaming benchmarks?

queries.query: What core mechanism does Mamba introduce to address the quadratic complexity of Transformers?
queries.gold_citation_passage: We introduce Mamba, a selective state space architecture that makes SSM parameters input-dependent, allowing the model to selectively propagate or forget information along the sequence dimension.

queries.query: What perplexity did Mamba-2.8B achieve on the Pile benchmark?

queries.query: How does FlashAttention avoid the quadratic memory access overhead of standard attention?
queries.gold_citation_passage: We propose FlashAttention, an IO-aware exact attention algorithm that uses tiling to reduce the number of memory reads/writes between GPU high bandwidth memory (HBM) and GPU on-chip SRAM.

queries.query: How early did foundation models identify occult sepsis compared to standard EHR rule-based alerts?
